author: Logos III
title: Logos III: SOTA Ablation Study - No Whitening
abstract: This is an ablation study on the Praxis SOTA pipeline. It tests the contribution of the '_whiten_pcs' step by removing it entirely. The standard (unstable) sc.pp.combat is used. The goal is to quantify the performance impact of the whitening step and determine its necessity for the high score.
